title: Private JSOC-veteran team behind Herrera and Barber retrievals

tellings.quote: it seems like Michael, the team he was dealing with, is the same team that Jake Barber is familiar with.

plain: A researcher known online as UAPGerb told podcast host Jesse Michels that two men, Michael Herrera and Jake Barber, each of whom has described dealing with recoveries of unknown craft, seem to have been dealing with the same private team. He suggests the team is made up of veterans of JSOC, the US military command that runs its most elite special forces units, and that it has been active since around 2009. If true, it would mean such recoveries are carried out by a private outfit rather than an ordinary government unit.
